H06.answer: This page provides detailed specifications for the SV-CH / SV-F universal milling machine, including its travel distances, feed speeds, motor power, and other technical details. Page 11

H07.answer: This section explains the leveling procedure for the milling machine. It involves using a level gauge to ensure the machine is level, positioning the table, saddle, and knee at the center of movement, and adjusting with jack bolts to ensure even load distribution. After adjustment, the machine should be rechecked for levelness. Page 26.

H08.answer: You should inspect the belt of the main spindle drive system every month. Turn off the main power source before inspection. Check for looseness and lacerations, and adjust the belt's movement volume to 10-20 mm. Page 68.
